_README: Operator-supplied price list, keyed by '<provider>/<model_id>' exactly as it appears
in a candidate manifest. Copy this file to configs/model_costs.json and fill in the
figures from your own provider contract or billing page.
It ships with null values on purpose. A price is a commercial fact about YOUR
agreement with a provider -- it cannot be derived from a benchmark run, it changes
without notice, and it differs between accounts, regions and commitment tiers.
A plausible-looking number invented here would be indistinguishable, in the admin
console, from a real one you had verified. So the pipeline reports cost as null
until a human supplies it, and the UI already renders that null state.
Any entry left null reports as null end-to-end. Delete keys you do not price.
